justification: Response misapplies antenna array concepts to PLC, which uses conductive coupling not radiating antennas. Claims about λ/2 spaced phased arrays and scattering theory are irrelevant and unsupported. It does not reference the high‑noise, attenuation challenges described in the context, nor provide concrete design guidance for minimizing loss on power lines. Consequently technical accuracy, context adherence, and actionable conclusion are all poor.
